repos_data.description: 📼 The missing YouTube and YouTube Music macOS app
A native macOS browser with Glance for quick lookups and optional local AI.

Run Android apps on your Mac like Mac apps: each in its own window with its own Dock icon, on Apple silicon. Notifications, game controllers, privacy controls. Free & open source (LineageOS + QEMU + scrcpy).
Transparent macOS disk cleaner — groups files by app, moves to Trash (never permanent). SwiftUI + Liquid Glass, built for macOS Tahoe.
Never keep an agent waiting. A free, open-source Mac menu bar app for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: see which session needs you and answer it with one keystroke.
A native, customizable menu bar for macOS, with themes, widgets, popups and AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspaces. A free, open-source alternative to SketchyBar.
Menu-bar file converter for macOS 26+. Drag a file, a wheel appears, drop it on what you want: video, audio, images, PDFs and links.

Be present. Reprise remembers. An open-source call recorder for macOS: it notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime and more, and records both sides at about 1% CPU, and the screen if you want, to plain files. It keeps the call through a lost mic, a new headset or a crash. Native Swift, no dependencies, MIT.
